title: File:Berlin, Mitte, Karl-Marx-Allee 48-52, Wohnblock.jpg
desc: Apartment block Karl-Marx-Allee 48/52 in Berlin-Mitte. The building was constructed during the final stage of development of the boulevard. The design is by the collective Josef Kaiser and Klaus Deutschmann. The buildings is part of the protected historic buildings area Karl-Marx-Allee.
